scope.spacetime: 3+1 unchanged; layer labels denote retained field-coordinate descriptions
scope.gauge: 33 eaten directions excluded from physical scalar response; PQ axion retained
scope.units: omega=1; J_HH and J_VV in omega, Yukawa vertices dimensionless; residue entries carry corresponding product units
scope.source_basis: scalar action and Yukawa/gauge vertices fixed before any source-rank decomposition; quark pairs use first matched colour in common-phase dictionary, not a colour-averaged bilinear
scope.IR: axion is massless only in this perturbative tree action; no QCD potential included

physical_axion.interpretation: Physical PQ tangent is the S phase; all declared linear probe residues vanish. It remains a physical zero mode, not a gauge artifact or absent state.
physical_axion.rejected_initial_hypothesis: NN would see a nonzero physical PQ scalar pole. The first run returned zero; support in S, absent from both Yukawa tensors, explains the failure without parameter changes.
